name: Pair of Boots
material: Silk: compound twill; silk and gold: tapestry; silk: tabby, gauze, and batting; leather
summary: The fabric and tailoring of garments have always defined social status. For these boots, different outer fabrics were used: a patterned silk for the leg portion, and tapestry (kesi) for the foot.
